# UKGigTax

> Free UK self-employment tax calculators and guides for gig workers 2026. Covers Uber, Deliveroo, Amazon Flex, Bolt Food, Just Eat. Class 4 NI 6%, Personal Allowance £12,570, Trading Allowance £1,000, mileage 45p/mile.
